[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Sorting the Sentence** [LC 1859 · Sorting the Sentence](https://leetcode.com/problems/sorting-the-sentence/){difficulty="Easy"}

Every word already names its own destination: the trailing digit *is* the index. That is the counting-sort situation in its purest form — the key is a small integer in a known range $[1, w]$, so instead of comparing words, write each straight into slot `d-1`. This is @sec-lts-a1's "value as address" with the address handed to us for free.
